taste.name: Let the Qur'an carry the colour
taste.trigger: When choosing a brand colour for a Qur'an app
taste.decision: Chose a black, white and cool-grey interface where the only colour is the green highlight inside the recorded app, over a brand green spread across buttons and headings
taste.reason: Because the text being memorised is the subject, and the highlight that tells a reciter where they are is the one place colour carries meaning
evidence: green appears only in the hero footage

taste.name: No shadows, no illustrations: photography does the depth
taste.trigger: When building a page in a category full of floating mockups and drop-shadowed cards
taste.decision: Chose zero box-shadows and a full-bleed video of a real phone in a real hand, over rendered device frames and elevated cards
taste.reason: Because a real hand on a real mushaf screen says people use this, and flat cards keep the page from reading as an advert
evidence: hero footage covers 30.8% of measured surface
cards are white 12px on a #F3F4F6 band with no elevation

taste.name: Headline set light, not loud
taste.trigger: When the hero needed one line to land at 1440px
taste.decision: Chose 96px at weight 400 with line-height 1.0, over a bold 700 display
taste.reason: Because large-and-light reads as calm confidence, while large-and-bold reads as a sales pitch, which is the wrong tone for a devotional product
